purpose: Autonomous multi-agent pipeline for researching, drafting, visualizing, and publishing high-engagement LinkedIn posts on personal profile via GitHub Actions

required_products: Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect
linkedin.how_to_get_person_urn: Call GET https://api.linkedin.com/v2/userinfo with Bearer token; read 'sub' field from JSON response; author URN is urn:li:person:{sub}. Note: Do NOT use deprecated /v2/me as it requires legacy r_liteprofile and will return 401.
known_invalid_token_causes: Querying deprecated /v2/me endpoint which requires legacy r_liteprofile instead of modern /v2/userinfo
Token generated without checking all 4 required scopes (openid, profile, email, w_member_social) in Developer Token Generator
Using token from app with unverified Company Page association or incomplete settings ('hakan growth bot')
Calling terminal curl without exporting LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN variable, sending empty Bearer header
Authenticated user is not assigned Developer or Admin role on the app in Development mode
Omitting LinkedIn-Version header on REST endpoints (/rest/posts or /rest/images)
Token expiration (Developer Token Generator tokens expire after 60 days)

other_secrets.name: NEWS_API_KEY
other_secrets.used_by: NewsApiConnector.get_top_ai_news in linkedin_agents.py (optional news headline scanner)

other_secrets.name: TAVILY_API_KEY
other_secrets.used_by: TavilyConnector.search_ai_context in linkedin_agents.py (optional agentic web search)

likely_causes: /v2/me was called instead of OpenID Connect /v2/userinfo endpoint
Developer Token was minted from 'hakan growth bot' which lacked OIDC product and had unverified page status
Scopes were partially selected in Token Generator tool (missing openid or w_member_social)
Missing LinkedIn-Version header (e.g. 202606) required for REST endpoints
Token environment variable empty in local test shell or GitHub Secret not updated
fix_checklist: Open LinkedIn Developer Portal and ensure 'github 1' app has Company Page verified and team roles assigned
Confirm both 'Share on LinkedIn' and 'Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect' products are Added
Open Token Generator, select 'github 1', check 'openid', 'profile', 'email', 'w_member_social', and generate token
Test token with: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN' https://api.linkedin.com/v2/userinfo
Extract 'sub' from userinfo response and construct LINKEDIN_PERSON_URN=urn:li:person:{sub}
Update GitHub Secrets LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN and LINKEDIN_PERSON_URN
Update config.yaml model to openai/gpt-oss-120b and .github/workflows/linkedin_scheduler.yml cron to '0 7 * * *'
Trigger workflow manually via GitHub Actions workflow_dispatch and verify status 201

do_not: commit real tokens, client secrets, or API keys into git repository
print or log secret values in GitHub Actions workflow output
use /v2/me endpoint with modern OIDC tokens (it will always return 401)
target company pages or enable the Healer agent until personal profile posting is stable
modify agent prompts or Critic rule enforcement without benchmarking against memory.json
next_actions_for_fixer: Verify 'github 1' developer app verification status and admin role in LinkedIn Developer Portal
Generate 60-day token with scopes: openid, profile, email, w_member_social
Execute /v2/userinfo curl to verify token and extract person ID ('sub')
Update GitHub repository secrets: LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN and LINKEDIN_PERSON_URN
Update config.yaml model.name to 'openai/gpt-oss-120b' and workflow cron to '0 7 * * *'
If /v2/ugcPosts is blocked by LinkedIn for newly issued tokens, update LinkedInConnector to use /rest/posts and /rest/images
